primary_work.title: Disentangling Dynamical Systems: Causal Representation Learning Meets Local Sparse Attention
primary_work.official_code: dedicated author-maintained repository not located from primary records or targeted title/code search

prior_art_boundary: Under injective trajectory generation, observational equivalence, faithful parameter-to-state DAG structure, path connectedness, learned graph no denser than truth, sufficient Jacobian variability, and a global or state-dependent local graphical criterion, raw trajectories identify system parameters up to permutation and element-wise diffeomorphism without language or intervention-target labels.
decision: NARROWED BEYOND STATE-DEPENDENT LOCAL-DYNAMICS IDENTIFIABILITY — NOT ADOPTED
rejected_claims: language dynamics pretraining is novel merely because it learns environment parameters before instruction following
language is required to disentangle system parameters from transition trajectories
next-state prediction plus sparse local influence establishes raw-language grounding
naming or paraphrasing trajectory-identifiable parameters jointly identifies utterance equivalence and target partition
task success or language-shuffle sensitivity proves semantic identifiability
counterexample: If language is generated from a trajectory-identifiable parameter statistic and the language generator is transformed jointly with an admissible parameter permutation/diffeomorphism, trajectory likelihood, prediction, task success, sparsity, paraphrase accuracy, and shuffle gaps can remain identical while utterance equivalence and fine target partitions differ. If L is conditionally independent of the residual partition given the full transition statistic, language cannot refine that partition.
remaining_rq: In systems where the strongest global and state-dependent local dynamics criteria leave an explicit residual parameter/target equivalence class, can a preregistered externally anchored population language channel provide a distinction not measurable from the complete transition process, prevent joint recoding, and jointly identify raw-utterance equivalence with a strict refinement of the residual intervention-target partition?
